name: anti-drift-guard
description: Always-on anti-hallucination and compaction-resilience rules: persist locked user decisions to disk, prevent multi-agent/Swarm silent rollbacks, verify workspace roots by modification time, and ban ungrounded claims about history or black-box checks.
suggestedPrompts: Persist all locked decisions and protected constraints from this phase into a workspace document
Verify the actual git and file timeline behind the discrepancy between the current file and the latest report
Audit whether our recent edits touched any previously verified sections that now require re-testing
